source_refs.note: Exercise 4.2, Question 2: Without expansion show ten determinant results, parts (i)-(x) (book pages 58-59).

blocks.explanation:
"Without expansion" ka matlab hai: determinant ko khol kar (expand kar ke) nahi, sirf properties of determinants se saabit karna hai.
Humein dikhana hai ke value 0 hai. Zero dikhane ke do aasaan raste hain: do columns (ya rows) ek jaise bana dein, ya ek poora column zero bana dein.
Plan: \(C_2\) aur \(C_3\) mein se \(C_1\) minus karein, phir naye columns ko compare karein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} 7 & 8 & 9 \\ 5 & 6 & 7 \\ 2 & 3 & 4 \end{vmatrix}\)
Saabit karna hai: \(\Delta = 0\), expansion ke baghair.
Tareeqa: Property vii (ek column ko doosre mein se minus karne se value nahi badalti), Property v (common factor bahar), Property iii (do ek jaise columns ho to value zero). Ishara: har row mein numbers 1 se barhte hain (\(7, 8, 9\)), is liye minus karne se chhote aur ek jaise numbers banenge.

Column 1 ko column 2 aur 3 mein se minus karein
\[C_2 - C_1 \to C_2,\quad C_3 - C_1 \to C_3\]
\[\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} 7 & 1 & 2 \\ 5 & 1 & 2 \\ 2 & 1 & 2 \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: \(8 - 7 = 1,\ 6 - 5 = 1,\ 3 - 2 = 1\) aur \(9 - 7 = 2,\ 7 - 5 = 2,\ 4 - 2 = 2\). Property vii kehti hai ke aisa karne se determinant ki value wohi rehti hai, sirf shakal aasaan ho jati hai.

Column 3 se 2 bahar nikalein
\[\Delta = 2\begin{vmatrix} 7 & 1 & 1 \\ 5 & 1 & 1 \\ 2 & 1 & 1 \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: \(C_3\) ki har entry 2 hai, to Property v se 2 poore determinant ke bahar aa gaya.

Ek jaise columns
\[\Delta = 2 \times 0 = 0\]
Kyun: Property iii: jab do columns (ya do rows) bilkul ek jaise hon to determinant zero hota hai. Wajah samajhiye: un dono ko aapas mein badlein to matrix wohi rehta hai, lekin Property ii ke mutabiq sign badal jana chahiye; \(\Delta = -\Delta\) sirf tab mumkin hai jab \(\Delta = 0\). Yahan \(C_2 = C_3\).

Tasdeeq (sirf tasalli ke liye; saboot mein expansion ki zaroorat nahi)
\[7(24 - 21) - 8(20 - 14) + 9(15 - 12)\]
\[= 21 - 48 + 27 = 0 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Row 1 ke along expand karne se bhi zero aaya. Exam mein yeh hissa likhna zaroori nahi, kyunke sawal "without expansion" keh raha hai.

blocks.explanation:
Phir "without expansion" wala saboot hai; value 0 dikhani hai.
Is dafa koi do columns seedhe ek jaise nahi bante, is liye hum aisa combination dhoondenge jo poora column zero kar de.
Plan: dekhein ke \(C_3 = C_1 - C_2\) hai; is liye \(C_3 - C_1 + C_2\) zero column banega.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} 5 & 6 & -1 \\ 2 & 2 & 0 \\ 2 & -8 & 10 \end{vmatrix}\)
Saabit karna hai: \(\Delta = 0\), expansion ke baghair.
Tareeqa: Property vii (columns ke multiples jama/minus karne se value nahi badalti) aur Property iv (zero column ho to value zero). Rishta kaise dhoonda? Har row mein pehli entry minus doosri entry dekhein: \(5 - 6 = -1\), \(2 - 2 = 0\), \(2 - (-8) = 10\). Yeh bilkul \(C_3\) ki entries hain!

\(C_3\) mein se \(C_1\) minus karein aur \(C_2\) jama karein
\[C_3 - C_1 + C_2 \to C_3\]
\[\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} 5 & 6 & 0 \\ 2 & 2 & 0 \\ 2 & -8 & 0 \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: Row 1: \(-1 - 5 + 6 = 0\); row 2: \(0 - 2 + 2 = 0\); row 3: \(10 - 2 - 8 = 0\). Yeh do Property vii wale qadam hain (pehle \(C_1\) minus, phir \(C_2\) jama), is liye value nahi badli.
Dhyan dein: Column operation mein hamesha woh column badalta hai jo arrow ke right par likha ho; \(C_1\) aur \(C_2\) waise ke waise rehte hain.

Zero column
\[\Delta = 0\]
Kyun: Property iv: jis determinant ka ek poora column zero ho, us ki value zero hoti hai, kyunke usi column ke along expand karein to har term zero se multiply hoti hai.

Tasdeeq (sirf tasalli ke liye)
\[5(20 - 0) - 6(20 - 0) + (-1)(-16 - 4)\]
\[= 100 - 120 + 20 = 0 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Row 1 ke along expansion bhi zero deti hai, to hamara saboot sahi hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 (iii) Without expansion show that: \(\begin{vmatrix} -a & 0 & b \\ 0 & a & -c \\ c & -b & 0 \end{vmatrix} = 0\)
blocks.explanation:
Letters wala "without expansion" saboot; value 0 dikhani hai.
Yahan columns ka koi seedha rishta nazar nahi aata, lekin rows ka rishta hai: \(a R_3 + c R_1 + b R_2\) zero row ban jati hai.
Plan: pehle \(R_3\) ko \(a\) se multiply (bahar \(\frac{1}{a}\) rakh kar), phir \(cR_1\) aur \(bR_2\) jama.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} -a & 0 & b \\ 0 & a & -c \\ c & -b & 0 \end{vmatrix}\)
Saabit karna hai: \(\Delta = 0\), expansion ke baghair.
Tareeqa: Property v (row ko \(a\) se multiply karne se value \(a\) guna ho jati hai), Property vii (rows ke multiples jama karna), Property iv (zero row). Pehle hum \(a \neq 0\) maan kar chalte hain, aur aakhir mein \(a = 0\) ko alag dekhenge, taake saboot har haalat mein poora ho.

\(R_3\) ko \(a\) se multiply karein
\[\Delta = \dfrac{1}{a}\begin{vmatrix} -a & 0 & b \\ 0 & a & -c \\ ac & -ab & 0 \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: Row ko \(a\) se multiply kiya to determinant bhi \(a\) guna ho gaya. Barabari qaim rakhne ke liye bahar \(\frac{1}{a}\) likh diya. Yeh aisa hi hai jaise kisi number ko 5 se multiply kar ke phir 5 se divide kar dein: asal number wohi rehta hai.

\(R_3\) mein \(cR_1\) aur \(bR_2\) jama karein
\[R_3 + cR_1 + bR_2 \to R_3\]
\[\Delta = \dfrac{1}{a}\begin{vmatrix} -a & 0 & b \\ 0 & a & -c \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: Column 1: \(ac + c(-a) + b(0) = 0\); column 2: \(-ab + c(0) + b(a) = 0\); column 3: \(0 + c(b) + b(-c) = 0\). Property vii se value nahi badli, aur poori row zero ho gayi.

Zero row
\[\Delta = \dfrac{1}{a} \times 0 = 0\]
Kyun: Property iv: zero row wala determinant zero hota hai.

Jab \(a = 0\) ho
\[\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} 0 & 0 & b \\ 0 & 0 & -c \\ c & -b & 0 \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: \(a = 0\) ho to hum \(\frac{1}{a}\) nahi likh sakte, is liye yeh case alag. Agar \(b \neq 0\) ho to \(R_2\) ko \(b\) se multiply kar ke \(cR_1\) jama karein: \(R_2 = (0, 0, -bc + bc) = (0, 0, 0)\), to \(\Delta = 0\). Agar \(b = 0\) bhi ho to \(R_1\) pehle hi zero row hai. Yani har haalat mein \(\Delta = 0\).
Dhyan dein: Kisi letter se divide karte waqt hamesha sochiye ke woh zero to nahi; achha saboot har case ko cover karta hai.

Tasdeeq (sirf tasalli ke liye)
\[-a(0 - bc) - 0 + b(0 - ac)\]
\[= abc - abc = 0 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Row 1 ke along expansion bhi zero deti hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 (iv) Without expansion show that: \(\begin{vmatrix} l & m+n & 1 \\ m & n+l & 1 \\ n & l+m & 1 \end{vmatrix} = 0\)
blocks.explanation:
"Without expansion" saboot; value 0 dikhani hai.
Ghaur karein: har row mein pehle do columns mil kar teeno letters \(l, m, n\) bana dete hain.
Plan: \(C_2 + C_1 \to C_2\), phir \(l + m + n\) bahar, phir \(C_2\) aur \(C_3\) compare.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} l & m+n & 1 \\ m & n+l & 1 \\ n & l+m & 1 \end{vmatrix}\)
Saabit karna hai: \(\Delta = 0\), expansion ke baghair.
Tareeqa: Property vii (column jama karna), Property v (common factor bahar), Property iii (ek jaise columns). Column 3 mein sirf 1 hain; agar hum \(C_2\) ko bhi 1 wala column bana dein to kaam ho jayega.

Column 1 ko column 2 mein jama karein
\[C_2 + C_1 \to C_2\]
\[\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} l & l+m+n & 1 \\ m & l+m+n & 1 \\ n & l+m+n & 1 \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: \(l + (m+n)\), \(m + (n+l)\), \(n + (l+m)\): teeno ka jawab \(l + m + n\) hai. Property vii se value wohi rahi.

Column 2 se \(l + m + n\) bahar nikalein
\[\Delta = (l+m+n)\begin{vmatrix} l & 1 & 1 \\ m & 1 & 1 \\ n & 1 & 1 \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: Property v: column 2 ki har entry mein \(l + m + n\) common hai.

Ek jaise columns
\[\Delta = (l+m+n) \times 0 = 0\]
Kyun: Property iii: jab do columns (ya do rows) bilkul ek jaise hon to determinant zero hota hai. Wajah samajhiye: un dono ko aapas mein badlein to matrix wohi rehta hai, lekin Property ii ke mutabiq sign badal jana chahiye; \(\Delta = -\Delta\) sirf tab mumkin hai jab \(\Delta = 0\). Yahan \(C_2 = C_3\).

blocks.explanation:
"Without expansion" saboot; value 0 dikhani hai.
Column 3 dekhein: \(3x, 9x, 15x\). Yeh sab \(3x\) ke multiples hain: \(3x \times 1,\ 3x \times 3,\ 3x \times 5\).
Plan: \(C_3\) se \(3x\) bahar, phir \(C_2\) aur \(C_3\) ko compare karein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} 2 & 1 & 3x \\ 2 & 3 & 9x \\ 3 & 5 & 15x \end{vmatrix}\)
Saabit karna hai: \(\Delta = 0\), expansion ke baghair.
Tareeqa: Property v (column ka common factor bahar) aur Property iii (ek jaise columns). Yeh sab se chhota saboot hai, bas factor pehchanna hai.

Column 3 se \(3x\) bahar nikalein
\[\Delta = 3x\begin{vmatrix} 2 & 1 & 1 \\ 2 & 3 & 3 \\ 3 & 5 & 5 \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: \(3x = 3x \cdot 1\), \(9x = 3x \cdot 3\), \(15x = 3x \cdot 5\). Factor nikalne ke baad \(C_3\) mein \(1, 3, 5\) bache, jo bilkul \(C_2\) jaise hain.

Ek jaise columns
\[\Delta = 3x \times 0 = 0\]
Kyun: Property iii: jab do columns (ya do rows) bilkul ek jaise hon to determinant zero hota hai. Wajah samajhiye: un dono ko aapas mein badlein to matrix wohi rehta hai, lekin Property ii ke mutabiq sign badal jana chahiye; \(\Delta = -\Delta\) sirf tab mumkin hai jab \(\Delta = 0\). Yahan \(C_2 = C_3\).

blocks.prompt: 2 (vi) Without expansion show that: \(\begin{vmatrix} 1 & p^2 & \frac{p}{qr} \\ 1 & q^2 & \frac{q}{rp} \\ 1 & r^2 & \frac{r}{pq} \end{vmatrix} = 0\)
blocks.explanation:
Fractions wala "without expansion" saboot; value 0 dikhani hai.
Column 3 ki teeno fractions ka denominator alag hai (\(qr, rp, pq\)), lekin teeno ko \(pqr\) par laaya ja sakta hai.
Plan: \(C_3\) ko \(pqr\) denominator par likhein, \(\frac{1}{pqr}\) bahar nikalein, phir \(C_2\) aur \(C_3\) compare karein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} 1 & p^2 & \frac{p}{qr} \\ 1 & q^2 & \frac{q}{rp} \\ 1 & r^2 & \frac{r}{pq} \end{vmatrix}\), jahan \(p, q, r \neq 0\).
Saabit karna hai: \(\Delta = 0\), expansion ke baghair.
Tareeqa: Denominators barabar karna (upar neeche ek hi number se multiply), phir Property v aur Property iii.

Column 3 ko \(pqr\) denominator par likhein
\[\dfrac{p}{qr} = \dfrac{p \cdot p}{qr \cdot p} = \dfrac{p^2}{pqr}\]
\[\dfrac{q}{rp} = \dfrac{q^2}{pqr},\quad \dfrac{r}{pq} = \dfrac{r^2}{pqr}\]
Kyun: Fraction ke numerator aur denominator dono ko ek hi non-zero number se multiply karne se fraction nahi badalti (jaise \(\frac{1}{2} = \frac{3}{6}\)). Pehli fraction mein \(p\) missing tha, us ko upar neeche lagaya; isi tarah doosri mein \(q\) aur teesri mein \(r\).

Column 3 se \(\frac{1}{pqr}\) bahar nikalein
\[\Delta = \dfrac{1}{pqr}\begin{vmatrix} 1 & p^2 & p^2 \\ 1 & q^2 & q^2 \\ 1 & r^2 & r^2 \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: Property v: \(C_3\) ki har entry mein \(\frac{1}{pqr}\) common hai.

Ek jaise columns
\[\Delta = \dfrac{1}{pqr} \times 0 = 0\]
Kyun: Property iii: jab do columns (ya do rows) bilkul ek jaise hon to determinant zero hota hai. Wajah samajhiye: un dono ko aapas mein badlein to matrix wohi rehta hai, lekin Property ii ke mutabiq sign badal jana chahiye; \(\Delta = -\Delta\) sirf tab mumkin hai jab \(\Delta = 0\). Yahan \(C_2 = C_3\).

blocks.prompt: 2 (vii) Without expansion show that: \(\begin{vmatrix} p-q & q-r & r-p \\ q-r & r-p & p-q \\ r-p & p-q & q-r \end{vmatrix} = 0\)
blocks.explanation:
"Without expansion" saboot; value 0 dikhani hai.
Pehli row ko jama kar ke dekhein: \((p - q) + (q - r) + (r - p) = 0\). Har row mein yahi teen brackets hain.
Plan: teeno columns ko \(C_1\) mein jama karein; zero column ban jayega.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} p-q & q-r & r-p \\ q-r & r-p & p-q \\ r-p & p-q & q-r \end{vmatrix}\)
Saabit karna hai: \(\Delta = 0\), expansion ke baghair.
Tareeqa: Property vii (columns ko ek column mein jama karna) aur Property iv (zero column). Jab har row ka total zero ho, yahi trick sab se tez hai.

Teeno columns ko column 1 mein jama karein
\[C_1 + C_2 + C_3 \to C_1\]
\[\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} 0 & q-r & r-p \\ 0 & r-p & p-q \\ 0 & p-q & q-r \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: Row 1: \(p - q + q - r + r - p = 0\), kyunke har letter ek dafa plus aur ek dafa minus aata hai. Row 2 aur 3 mein wohi teen brackets doosri tarteeb mein hain, is liye un ka total bhi 0 hai.

Zero column
\[\Delta = 0\]
Kyun: Property iv: ek poora column zero ho to determinant zero hota hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 (viii) Without expansion show that: \(\begin{vmatrix} yz & zx & xy \\ x & y & z \\ \frac{1}{x} & \frac{1}{y} & \frac{1}{z} \end{vmatrix} = 0\)
blocks.explanation:
"Without expansion" saboot; value 0 dikhani hai.
Row 1 mein \(yz, zx, xy\) hain aur row 3 mein \(\frac{1}{x}, \frac{1}{y}, \frac{1}{z}\). Agar \(C_1\) ko \(x\) se, \(C_2\) ko \(y\) se aur \(C_3\) ko \(z\) se multiply karein, to row 1 poori \(xyz\) aur row 3 poori 1 ban jayegi.
Plan: yeh multiplication, phir \(R_1\) se \(xyz\) bahar, phir \(R_1\) aur \(R_3\) compare.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} yz & zx & xy \\ x & y & z \\ \frac{1}{x} & \frac{1}{y} & \frac{1}{z} \end{vmatrix}\), jahan \(x, y, z \neq 0\).
Saabit karna hai: \(\Delta = 0\), expansion ke baghair.
Tareeqa: Property v ko dono taraf istemal karenge: column ko \(k\) se multiply karein to value \(k\) guna; aur common factor bahar nikal sakte hain. Phir Property iii (ek jaise rows).

\(C_1\) ko \(x\), \(C_2\) ko \(y\), \(C_3\) ko \(z\) se multiply karein
\[\Delta = \dfrac{1}{xyz}\begin{vmatrix} xyz & xyz & xyz \\ x^2 & y^2 & z^2 \\ 1 & 1 & 1 \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: \(yz \cdot x = xyz\), \(zx \cdot y = xyz\), \(xy \cdot z = xyz\); row 2: \(x \cdot x = x^2\) waghera; row 3: \(\frac{1}{x} \cdot x = 1\) waghera. Teen columns ko \(x, y, z\) se multiply kiya to value \(xyz\) guna ho gayi; barabari ke liye bahar \(\frac{1}{xyz}\) likha.

Row 1 se \(xyz\) bahar nikalein
\[\Delta = \dfrac{xyz}{xyz}\begin{vmatrix} 1 & 1 & 1 \\ x^2 & y^2 & z^2 \\ 1 & 1 & 1 \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: Property v: \(R_1\) ki har entry \(xyz\) hai.

Ek jaise rows
\[\Delta = 1 \times 0 = 0\]
Kyun: Property iii: yahan \(R_1 = R_3\) hai, is liye determinant zero hai. Rows ka swap karne se sign badalna chahiye lekin matrix wohi rehta hai; yeh sirf zero ke liye mumkin hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 (ix) Without expansion show that: \(\begin{vmatrix} bc & a & a^2 \\ ca & b & b^2 \\ ab & c & c^2 \end{vmatrix} = \begin{vmatrix} 1 & a^2 & a^3 \\ 1 & b^2 & b^3 \\ 1 & c^2 & c^3 \end{vmatrix}\)
blocks.explanation:
Yahan zero nahi, balkay do determinants ki barabari "without expansion" saabit karni hai.
Right side mein pehla column 1 ka hai aur baaqi \(a^2, a^3\). Left side ki row 1 \(bc, a, a^2\) ko \(a\) se multiply karein to \(abc, a^2, a^3\) banti hai: power khud barh gayi!
Plan: \(R_1, R_2, R_3\) ko \(a, b, c\) se multiply karein; phir \(C_1\) se \(abc\) bahar.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: left side \(\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} bc & a & a^2 \\ ca & b & b^2 \\ ab & c & c^2 \end{vmatrix}\), jahan \(a, b, c \neq 0\).
Saabit karna hai: \(\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} 1 & a^2 & a^3 \\ 1 & b^2 & b^3 \\ 1 & c^2 & c^3 \end{vmatrix}\), expansion ke baghair.
Tareeqa: Property v do dafa: pehle rows ko multiply karna (bahar divide likh kar), phir column ka common factor bahar nikalna.

\(R_1\) ko \(a\), \(R_2\) ko \(b\), \(R_3\) ko \(c\) se multiply karein
\[\Delta = \dfrac{1}{abc}\begin{vmatrix} abc & a^2 & a^3 \\ abc & b^2 & b^3 \\ abc & c^2 & c^3 \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: Row 1: \(bc \cdot a = abc\), \(a \cdot a = a^2\), \(a^2 \cdot a = a^3\). Row 2 aur 3 mein bhi isi tarah. Value \(abc\) guna hui, is liye bahar \(\frac{1}{abc}\) likha.

Column 1 se \(abc\) bahar nikalein
\[\Delta = \dfrac{abc}{abc}\begin{vmatrix} 1 & a^2 & a^3 \\ 1 & b^2 & b^3 \\ 1 & c^2 & c^3 \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= \begin{vmatrix} 1 & a^2 & a^3 \\ 1 & b^2 & b^3 \\ 1 & c^2 & c^3 \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: Property v: \(C_1\) ki har entry \(abc\) hai. \(\frac{abc}{abc} = 1\), aur jo bacha woh bilkul right side hai.
Dhyan dein: Rows ko multiply kiya aur column se factor nikala; dono jaiz hain kyunke Property v rows aur columns dono par lagti hai.
blocks.final_answer: Saabit ho gaya: dono determinants barabar hain.

blocks.prompt: 2 (x) Without expansion show that: \(\begin{vmatrix} 2a & a+b & a+c \\ 2b & 2b & b+c \\ 2c & b+c & 2c \end{vmatrix} = 0\)
blocks.explanation:
"Without expansion" saboot; value 0 dikhani hai.
Column 1 hai \(2a, 2b, 2c\); is ka aadha \(a, b, c\) hai. Column 2 aur 3 ki entries mein bhi \(a, b, c\) chhupe hain.
Plan: \(C_2\) aur \(C_3\) mein se \(\frac{1}{2}C_1\) minus karein; phir \(b\) aur \(c\) bahar.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} 2a & a+b & a+c \\ 2b & 2b & b+c \\ 2c & b+c & 2c \end{vmatrix}\)
Saabit karna hai: \(\Delta = 0\), expansion ke baghair.
Tareeqa: Property vii (ek column ka multiple doosre mein se minus), Property v (common factor), Property iii (ek jaise columns). Multiple \(\frac{1}{2}\) bhi ho sakta hai; property mein koi bhi number \(k\) chalta hai.

Column 2 aur 3 mein se aadha column 1 minus karein
\[C_2 - \tfrac{1}{2}C_1 \to C_2,\quad C_3 - \tfrac{1}{2}C_1 \to C_3\]
\[\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} 2a & b & c \\ 2b & b & c \\ 2c & b & c \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{1}{2}C_1 = (a, b, c)\). Naya \(C_2\): \((a+b) - a = b\), \(2b - b = b\), \((b+c) - c = b\). Naya \(C_3\): \((a+c) - a = c\), \((b+c) - b = c\), \(2c - c = c\). Property vii se value wohi.

\(C_2\) se \(b\) aur \(C_3\) se \(c\) bahar nikalein
\[\Delta = bc\begin{vmatrix} 2a & 1 & 1 \\ 2b & 1 & 1 \\ 2c & 1 & 1 \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: Property v: \(C_2\) mein sab \(b\) aur \(C_3\) mein sab \(c\) hain.

Ek jaise columns
\[\Delta = bc \times 0 = 0\]
Kyun: Property iii: jab do columns (ya do rows) bilkul ek jaise hon to determinant zero hota hai. Wajah samajhiye: un dono ko aapas mein badlein to matrix wohi rehta hai, lekin Property ii ke mutabiq sign badal jana chahiye; \(\Delta = -\Delta\) sirf tab mumkin hai jab \(\Delta = 0\). Yahan \(C_2 = C_3\).
